summary: Two slices prototyped on a scratch copy (07a state: unit 1551 + integration 503 green; 07a+07b: unit 1575 + integration 520, lint and tsc clean). 07a = 3 ordered parts (atomic cutover cannot be cut finer). 0031 is a RESYNC (repeat of 0030 + newer-old-row-wins updates, one event per changed stage, value upserts; removals not mirrored); deleteCrmForOrgs added (skip if slice 06 already defines it); W1 fields[{fieldId|key,value}], W2 default seller to caller in both editions, A1 followups shape, A2 advance returns {lead}, fields in POST/PATCH responses. Deviations: POST /sales never sets sale_id (conversion stays moveLead with saleId); no server proposta period filter (web filters bootstrap; SP-day range helper added to shared-utils); new orgs get the 7-etapa default pipeline (was 4); create writes the initial history event in 07a; timeline ascending; cross-pipeline move is 409; move enforces the graph with an import-only skip option; schema names LeadWriteSchema/LeadWriteBaseSchema/LeadPatchSchema; contact rule only on HTTP create (import exempt); CLAUDE.md and kanban reference edits owned by 07b.
